question: Which district in Nagaland was officially declared as the state's 17th district in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is /__**Meluri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio** officially inaugurated **Meluri District** as the 17th district of **Nagaland** at a function held at the public ground, Meluri.
 
• **Meluri** was notified as the 17th district on **November 2, 2024**.
 
• Meluri's administrative center was established **67 years ago**, with a **Chairman Bench Court** set up in 1958.
 
• Chief Minister Rio called Meluri the "**Land of Fortunes**" emphasizing the district’s natural and cultural wealth.
 
• Prominent landmarks in Meluri include **Shiloi Lake**, **Tizu River** (connects to the Chindwin River), and the **Trade Centre at Avakhung**.
 
• The event included the unveiling of a monolith marking the inauguration and the opening of the **Multidiscipline Sports Stadium**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cultural Significance:**

 
 
• Meluri has a rich cultural heritage reflected in its diverse cultural troupes and organizations like the Lozaphuhu Cultural troupe, Meluri Area Public Organisation.
 
• The newly formed district promotes unity among the **Chakhesang** and **Pochury tribes** and the broader Naga community.
 
 
 
• **Administrative Development:**
 
 
• The creation of Meluri District is aimed at improving **administrative efficiency** and fostering development in the region.
 
• Deputy Commissioner of Meluri highlighted the district’s profile, emphasizing its strategic importance and development potential.
